titles.title: Impeaching Peter Brian Hegseth, Secretary of Defense, for high crimes and misdemeanors.
Impeaching Peter Brian Hegseth, Secretary of Defense, for high crimes and misdemeanors.

action.text: QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE - Mr. Massie rose to a question of the privileges of the House and offered the resolution. The Chair directed the Clerk to report the resolution. Upon examination of the resolution, the Chair determined that the resolution did constitute a question of the privileges of the House.
Mr. Issa moved to refer to the Judiciary.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on motion to refer H. Res. 1655.
The previous question on the motion to refer was ordered without objection.
On motion to refer Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 211 - 204 (Roll no. 317).
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
